newsitem.title: FRANCE: Major forex levels "rather helpful" - OECD economist.
newsitem.headline: Major forex levels "rather helpful" - OECD economist.

text.p: OECD chief economist Stephen Potter said on Thursday that current currency exchange rates among big economies were "rather helpful".

Potter, who is acting chief economist at the Paris-based Organisation for Economic Co-Operation and Development, told reporters that the OECD did not try to establish what would be considered as an ideal equilibrium level. But, Potter told reporters, "in the present economic climate, the current set of exchange rates is seen as rather helpful".
He was speaking to reporters after the OECD released its twice-yearly Economic Outlook report.
